Fixed. The issue was in the `visitType` methods of both handlers: when config-based defaults (`lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultPrivate`/`defaultFinal`) were enabled, records fell through to `generateFieldDefaultsForType`, which then errored with "@FieldDefaults is only supported on a class or an enum."

Changes:
- `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleFieldDefaults.java:176` — skip records (`RECORD` flag) when no explicit `@FieldDefaults` annotation is present, just like interfaces/annotations.
- `src/core/lombok/eclipse/handlers/HandleFieldDefaults.java:157` — same skip using `Eclipse.AccRecord`.

Explicit `@FieldDefaults` on a record still errors (the existing `FieldDefaultsOnRecord` message test passes), and `FieldDefaultsViaConfigOnRecord` now passes. The remaining 4 test failures were verified pre-existing on the baseline and unrelated to this change.
